about.title: About Harish Motors
about.subtitle: Trusted roadside assistance in Delhi since 2000
about.story: Founded by Harish Chand in 2000, Harish Motors has been Delhi NCR's trusted roadside assistance partner for over 25 years. What started as a small garage in Kilokari has grown into a full-service mobile breakdown assistance team covering all of Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, and Ghaziabad.
about.missionText: To provide fast, reliable, and affordable roadside assistance to every stranded motorist in Delhi NCR, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How quickly can you reach me?
faq.a1: We typically reach anywhere in Delhi NCR within 20-40 minutes depending on traffic and location.
faq.q2: Do you service both cars and bikes?
faq.a2: Yes, we provide breakdown assistance for both cars and bikes of all makes and models.
faq.a3: We cover all of Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, and surrounding NCR areas.
faq.a4: Yes, we operate 24/7 including all national holidays and festivals.
faq.a5: We accept cash, UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), and bank transfers.
faq.q6: Do you provide towing for long distances?
faq.a6: Yes, we can tow your vehicle anywhere within NCR and even to nearby cities upon request.
